verdict.rationale: The docs give a short install path: a one-line `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` route via Claude Code's official marketplace, or an installer that writes editable skill files into your project. The site summarizes the flow as "install the ones you want, then type a slash command," and a one-time setup skill configures the repo. missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step quickstart page, any evidence the flow takes under five minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
